Identity: phone 7245550463 + DOB 1968-03-22 → "Identity verified … (2 detail(s) matched)". Passive persona: if asked, he "switched to a nasal pillows mask in August and ha[s] been buying pillows at the Uniontown branch, after trying a nasal cushion once"; confirms the late-September box (water chamber, filters, headgear, tubing) came by mail; wants it rushed to the house; agrees to corrections/charges on the card; pays "exactly that amount" with the handed-over tool. The rush payment is the patient's own tool (`pay_expedited_shipping_41dc5e4a`: "This is the patient's own tool").

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse

Act now. Enrollment `Self-Pay Supply Subscription`, `status: active`, `auto_ship: True`, rx 2026-02-02 (12-month order validity), no coverage records ("No matching records"). Expedited is "the patient's own request and is charged to the card on file, never to coverage". Self-Pay accepts no phone refill request, but a standing-order line for an auto-ship patient "ships on its cycle without a refill confirmation" (clause 2). Expedited transit 2 business days (rate card) → arrives before 2026-10-19.

- Booking the standing order without the style hop: excluded by S; it would ship A7031 (the recorded full_face item).
- Rush share alternative 90% (newest ground charge 2026-09-14, 30 days) arises only if E2 is skipped; E2 closes it.
- Fall-back vs reached: style full_face vs nasal_pillows; line A7033×3 51.30 2027-01-13 vs A7033×6 96.90 2026-12-13; ground charge nothing vs 2.97; rush 14.95 vs 3.80.
